description: Returns the documented upstream API response directly without an additional wrapper.

fields.name: stdout
fields.description: AI overview content in Markdown format; outputs key points and reference source links for each question's AI overview in order

fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.description: Target URL that was crawled, the final Google search page URL

fields.name: resultsNum
fields.description: Number of AI overview blocks; >0 indicates the page rendered an AI Overview, 0 indicates the keyword did not trigger an AI Overview

fields.name: code
fields.description: Business status code, success is "200" (same as the numeric errcode)

fields.name: errcode
fields.description: Business status code (HTTP layer is generally 200; business success/failure is determined by this field)

fields.name: msg/errmsg
fields.description: Response message, ok on success

fields.name: costTime
fields.description: API latency in milliseconds

fields.name: costToken
fields.description: Token consumption for this call; billed only when upstream returns success

fields.name: taskId
fields.description: Upstream capture task identifier for this request

fields.name: type
fields.description: Render style, fixed stdoutWorkbenches, used with the stdout field for Markdown rendering

fields.name: errmsg
fields.description: Upstream status message returned by the provider.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Provider-specific status message.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Provider-specific message.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Provider-specific response title.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.description: Provider-specific source platform type.

fields.name: sourceTool
fields.description: Provider-specific source tool name.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Page size returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageItemCount
fields.description: Item count on the current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: totalPage
fields.description: Total page count returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: dataSnapshotMonth
fields.description: Data snapshot month returned by the upstream provider.
